description: This file implements the NetlinkRequest class, which constructs and manages netlink messages for network configuration and communication with the Linux kernel. It includes methods for appending raw data, adding network interface information, address info, MAC addresses, and managing nested attribute lists.

classes.name: NetlinkRequest
classes.description: A class for constructing and managing netlink messages for network configuration.

methods.name: SeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the netlink message.

methods.name: AppendRaw
methods.description: Appends raw data to the netlink request buffer.

methods.name: ReserveRaw
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for raw data and returns a pointer to it.

methods.name: AppendTag
methods.description: Appends a netlink attribute (tag) with data to the request.

methods.name: NetlinkRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing a netlink request with command and flags.

methods.name: AddString
methods.description: Adds a string attribute to the netlink message.

methods.name: AddIfInfo
methods.description: Adds network interface information to the message.

methods.name: AddAddrInfo
methods.description: Adds address information to the message.
